description.value: A newly renovated Best Western Plus hotel on Kingsway in central Burnaby, positioned minutes from Metropolis at Metrotown — the Vancouver area's largest shopping mall. The property markets comfort and convenience for travelers exploring Greater Vancouver, with easy access to transit and urban amenities. Its location on a major arterial corridor makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists navigating the Greater Vancouver region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Best Western corporate website confirms the hotel's address (5411 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 2G1) and shows an active booking interface, establishing the property is real and open. Property-level amenity filter tags at the top of the page — 'free-breakfast' and 'free-high-speed-internet' — are Best Western's per-property feature indicators, confirming those two amenities. No mention of bike storage, cycling procedures, laundry, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel confirmed via active booking interface. A practical accommodation option for touring cyclists in the Burnaby/Vancouver area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The fetched website content is generic Best Western corporate pages with limited property-specific detail beyond address, amenity tags, and overview text. Cycling-specific amenities could not be verified and would require direct contact with the property.
